title: Over-Returning Support Lookup
summary: A customer support lookup that returns whole records, including SSNs, dates of birth, card numbers, and internal notes, with no masking, field projection, or pagination.
notes: Fixtures are synthetic: reserved .invalid TLD and 000-xx-xxxx SSNs. The two labels are separated by blast radius (one record vs. the whole table), which is the distinction that most often separates a medium finding from a critical one.
